Tiny Lisp

The tokenizer

Let's write a small interpreter. First we split source code into tokens.

function tokenize(src) { return src.replace(/\(/g, ' ( ').replace(/\)/g, ' ) ').trim().split(/\s+/); }

The parser

function parse(tokens) { const t = tokens.shift(); if (t === '(') { const list = []; while (tokens[0] !== ')') list.push(parse(tokens)); tokens.shift(); return list; } return isNaN(t) ? t : Number(t); }

Try it

(define square (lambda (x) (* x x)))
(square 12)
